text: The account holder, Mehwish Butt, received 11 inbound IBFT transfers between 4‑9 May 2026 totaling PKR 1,020,000 from 8 distinct counterparties, each from different synthetic banks. The pattern shows a high volume of small to medium sized deposits (PKR 18,000–90,000) within a short 14‑day window, followed by a single large outbound transfer of PKR 162,000 to a QuickPay wallet on 10 May and two large ATM withdrawals (PKR 170,000 on 12 May and PKR 63,000 on 13 May). The inbound transfers are from synthetic entities and the outbound wallet transfer is unusually large relative to the account’s declared monthly income (PKR 140,000). The rapid conversion of inbound funds into cash and a wallet suggests potential layering and placement typical of money‑laundering schemes. The alert system flagged “Many distinct inbound counterparties in 14 days” and “Large share of inbound value leaves quickly,” confirming the suspicious nature of the activity. Therefore, this case warrants filing a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR).
